method: Desk research using supplier product publications. Product-family evidence is not plant approval, an executable quote, proof of origin or confirmed availability. No quantity discount was verified in the cited publications.

suppliers.name: Asturiana de Zinc
suppliers.evidence: Spanish producer publishes zinc Z1 / SHG at 99.995%. Confirm current allocation and delivery.

suppliers.name: ACOMET Metales y Minerales
suppliers.evidence: Spanish distributor publishes zinc ingots with nominal 99.995% zinc and Z1 specification. Confirm original smelter and shipment origin; distributor location is not proof of origin.

suppliers.name: A.M.P.E.R.E. Spain
suppliers.evidence: Spanish sales page lists SHG zinc ingots above 99.995% purity in approximately one-tonne packs. Generic stock claims are not dated availability for your order; confirm quote and origin.

suppliers.name: ArcelorMittal Asturias / Aviles
suppliers.evidence: Official Spanish mill page lists hot-rolled coils. Confirm grade, dimensions, qualification and delivery.

suppliers.name: Cortichapa
suppliers.evidence: Spanish service centre publishes hot-rolled coil processing into sheets and strips. Confirm full-coil versus processed-product supply and original mill/origin.

suppliers.name: Hierros Marcelino Franco Group
suppliers.evidence: Spanish distributor publishes hot-rolled sheet/plate sales and cutting. Product-family lead only: full-coil supply, grade and original mill require confirmation.

suppliers.name: Domestic Mill A
suppliers.evidence: Publishes hot-rolled coil product capabilities.

suppliers.name: Tata Steel
suppliers.evidence: Publishes a hot-rolled coil product declaration for its Indian hot strip mills.

suppliers.name: Steel Authority of India (SAIL)
suppliers.evidence: Publishes HR coil and sheet product information.

suppliers.name: Nippon Steel
suppliers.evidence: Publishes a hot-rolled steel sheet and coil catalogue.

suppliers.name: JFE Steel
suppliers.evidence: Publishes hot-rolled sheet products under public and JFE standards.

suppliers.name: POSCO International
suppliers.evidence: Publishes hot-rolled steel in its traded steel product range. Confirm supplying mill and shipment origin in the RFQ.

suppliers.name: Hoa Phat
suppliers.evidence: Publishes hot-rolled coil products and standards.

suppliers.name: Hindustan Zinc
suppliers.evidence: Publishes Special High Grade zinc with minimum 99.995% purity.

suppliers.name: Varman Metals
suppliers.evidence: Supplier catalogue lists SHG zinc at 99.995%. Confirm original smelter, country of origin and current stock; not yet plant-qualified.

suppliers.name: Radiant Metals & Alloys
suppliers.evidence: Publishes domestic and imported SHG zinc ingots with minimum 99.995% zinc. Confirm the actual smelter and shipment origin.

suppliers.name: Hanwa
suppliers.evidence: Trading division lists zinc ingots and scrap. SHG specification, supplying smelter and Japanese origin are NOT established; this is an RFQ lead only.

suppliers.name: Nyrstar Australia / Hobart
suppliers.evidence: Nyrstar publishes zinc product data sheets including A-Z Z1. Confirm Australian production origin and current Hobart availability.

suppliers.name: Sun Metals
suppliers.evidence: Australian refinery near Townsville publishes Special High Grade zinc production meeting LME registration standards. Confirm current allocation and delivery.

suppliers.name: Consolidated Alloys / CA Group
suppliers.evidence: Publishes a Special High Grade zinc ingot/slab technical sheet at 99.995% purity. Older technical evidence, not current stock; confirm original smelter and Australian shipment origin.

suppliers.name: Young Poong
suppliers.evidence: Publishes high-purity zinc ingots; corporate site states 99.995% purity. Confirm current operating availability and allocation.

suppliers.name: Hyundai Corporation
suppliers.evidence: Trading company's nonferrous range includes zinc ingot. SHG purity and actual shipment origin are NOT established by this listing; confirm both before qualifying.

suppliers.name: DOWA Metals & Mining / Akita Zinc
suppliers.evidence: Zinc business publication describes Akita refinery zinc of at least 99.995% purity. Confirm commercial sales entity and shipment availability.

suppliers.name: Hyundai Steel
suppliers.evidence: Publishes hot-rolled coil grades and dimensions. Confirm required standard, mill and delivery schedule.

suppliers.name: Hyundai Corporation
suppliers.evidence: Steel trading publication lists hot-rolled steel products. Trading location is not proof of Korean origin; supplying mill must be confirmed.

suppliers.name: Kobe Steel
suppliers.evidence: Publishes hot-rolled steel sheet capabilities. Catalogue is older technical evidence, not current stock or an offer.

suppliers.name: Korea Zinc
suppliers.evidence: Publishes Special High Grade zinc slab ingots at 99.995% purity or higher.

suppliers.name: Mitsui Kinzoku
suppliers.evidence: Publishes zinc products including HSC-SHG. Confirm exact purity and supplying smelter in the RFQ.
